sayLines.line: Theo is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.

◈ FLASHBACK — Spare Socks
The flood year, three days in wet boots. Your feet went white and strange. The medic packed them with yarrow and told you: dry socks are civilization. Never again, you said.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Yarrow — white flowers, feathery leaves. Stops bleeding. The medic taught you.
Giulia came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
💡 KNOWLEDGE COMBINES: Sassafras — Level 3. You knew it was safe. the village and a trader knew the rest. Together, it's deeper. Uses: root tea for morale and mild medicine. Leaves thicken stew.
❓ Theo just told you something about Jordan — says they're not really a paramedic. Worth remembering.
👂 Overheard — Theo (to David): "Funny you should ask." Theo glances over their shoulder. "Jordan's been polishing that story. The unpolished version: a paramedic. Keep my name out of it."
🧭 Pearl is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Jordan Cao, 38 — a paramedic. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
🎒 Ivan shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
Oliver came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
🎒 Oliver is leaving — not foraging. Really leaving. "I'll bring back something worth the walk."
🎒 Pearl is leaving — not foraging. Really leaving. "I'll bring back something worth the walk."
David is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
🧭 Oliver is back from far past the south (+2508 kcal for the pantry, strange meat (unknown flesh — test it cautiously), 2 stories) (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Carlos is back from far past the north (strange meat (unknown flesh — test it cautiously), 3 stories) (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Dale is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
Pearl came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
🎒 "Gone a while," Oliver says, already walking. "If I'm not back in a few days... well. I'll be back."
🧭 Ivan is back from far past the east (+4731 kcal for the pantry, strange meat (unknown flesh — test it cautiously), 6 stories) (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Theo is back from past the north (+4916 kcal for the pantry, strange meat (unknown flesh — test it cautiously), 4 stories) (Ask them what they saw.)
🧭 Pearl is back from past the north (+3559 kcal for the pantry, 1 story) (Ask them what they saw.)
The System notes the synergy — healed someone back from the brink: +2 craft XP.

You have Wound Fever. Wound Fever — infection in an open cut. Clean it properly (field medicine, triage), poultice it (herbal), or hit it with antibiotics. All three work. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the east sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Oliver.
🧭 Giulia is back from the west. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
Dale came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Giulia came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The village threw out spoiled stores: 3 Expedition haul. (pantry)
Lisa came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Dale came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Tarek came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
📓 Codex: Maya taught David Herbal Medicine.
📓 Codex: David taught Angelo Herbal Medicine.
✦ Maya has found something — Field Pharmacy. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (field_pharmacy: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Maya has found something — Fever's End. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (fevers_end: villager synergy discovered)
✦ David has found something — Field Pharmacy. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (field_pharmacy: villager synergy discovered)
✦ David has found something — Fever's End. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (fevers_end: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Angelo has found something — Field Pharmacy. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (field_pharmacy: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Angelo has found something — Fever's End. Days of field_medicine and herbal_remedy side by side, and now they move as one. (fevers_end: villager synergy discovered)
David came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
